sources.name: ParaRev annotated subset
sources.relationship_notes: Dataset card declares CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The importer is opt-in and local-only. ParaRev is extracted from CASIMIR; do not count overlapping examples as independent. The license declaration does not resolve rights in underlying paper text; review before public redistribution or commercial use.

sources.name: CASIMIR
sources.relationship_notes: The Hugging Face dataset card declares MIT, but the corpus contains OpenReview scientific articles. Review upstream article rights and all included third-party content before use or redistribution.

sources.name: JFLEG
sources.reported_size: 1,503 sentence sources, each with four human corrections
sources.relationship_notes: Dataset card declares CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. This is a general grammatical-error-correction benchmark, not an academic-writing corpus. Keep it as a separate auxiliary benchmark, not mixed into academic paragraph training data.

sources.name: Individually licensed open-access papers
sources.relationship_notes: Review each article license and terms individually; open access alone is not a redistribution grant.
